statement: The target must not be moved beyond an opposing level merely to make risk-to-reward look acceptable. In a range this is called a very bad idea; in a trend, extending the target past a prior swing high is described as a defensible but lower-probability choice may be the preferred target-selection approach, pending further evidence.
